## Source
.design/m5/49-hardware-token-signing.md — REQ-3, REQ-7 + decomposition PR 1.

## Surface
- Extend `polaris_backend::labeler::signer::SigningError` with three new variants:
  - `WouldBlock` — no signer reachable; caller queues
  - `PhysicalPresenceTimeout` — touch not received within window
  - `TokenDisconnected` — token removed mid-session

## Rust-quality notes
- **Additive enum extension** — v1 impls (file_plain, passphrase_sealed, os_keychain, cloud_kms) never return these new variants; their behavior is unchanged. Per rust-quality §1: this is the right way to extend an enum.
- Per rust-quality §3: each variant has a `# Errors`-relevant doc-comment.
- Document in the trait's doc-comment that `WouldBlock` callers MUST queue (treat the label as `signature_status = 'PendingSignature'`), NOT retry immediately.
- Per rust-quality §7: regression test asserting v1 impls never construct the new variants (compile-time exhaustive match catches future drift).

## External references
- v1 SigningError: `polaris-backend/src/labeler/signer/mod.rs`
- `std::io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock` semantics (the inspiration): https://doc.rust-lang.org/std/io/enum.ErrorKind.html

## Acceptance
- [ ] `SigningError::{WouldBlock, PhysicalPresenceTimeout, TokenDisconnected}` exist.
- [ ] v1 impls compile-test confirms none constructs the new variants.
- [ ] Doc-comment on `WouldBlock` names the queue-don't-retry semantic.
